name: genctx
description: Attach LLM context invisibly to your source files. Click to pack any file for pasting into any LLM.

commands.title: genctx: Pack current file to clipboard
genctx: Pack current file with the context of its imports
genctx: Copy project map to clipboard
genctx: Reindex current file (force Ollama regeneration)

genctx.autoStartDaemon.description: Start the genctxd daemon in the background when it is not already running.

genctx.daemonPath.description: Absolute path to the genctxd binary. Leave empty to use PATH resolution.

genctx.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama base URL to use instead of gencontext.yaml's. Needed for a remote Ollama: a repository's gencontext.yaml may only point at this machine. Applies to CLI calls and to a daemon this extension starts (restart an already-running genctxd to pick it up).

genctx.statusBarAlignment.description: Which side of the status bar to show the genctx indicator.

genctx.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the genctx binary. Leave empty to use PATH resolution (recommended after running `cpctx setup`).
